stem.text: The diagram shows the Boltzmann distribution of energies in a gas. The gas can take part in a reaction with an activation energy, $E_\text{a}$. The gas is maintained at a constant temperature.

stem.alt: Boltzmann distribution curve: proportion of molecules with a given energy against molecular energy, peak labelled P, activation energy E_a marked on the molecular energy axis with the area beyond E_a shaded.

A.text: If a catalyst is added, peak P will be lower and $E_\text{a}$ will move to the left.

B.text: If a catalyst is added, peak P will be lower and $E_\text{a}$ will move to the right.

C.text: If a catalyst is added, peak P will be the same and $E_\text{a}$ will move to the left.

D.text: If a catalyst is added, peak P will be the same and $E_\text{a}$ will move to the right.
